title: Send leaves part of the text behind

message.text: Two things, both passed to mastermind-servex for manager-prompt-mechanics-2: send each sentence as soon as it's complete, and find out why Send left most of the long text behind, since it should submit the whole box. Those are its files, so I haven't touched them.

Taken: added to the dictation minion already fixing Send. Send will post everything the box shows and then empty it. It will be tested with a 2,000-character box plus a pending guess. I'll tell you here when it lands.

Landed, live and uncommitted: Send now posts everything the box shows, the half-said guess included, then empties it. It was proven headless with a fake clock. I did not see the 2,000-character result in the minion's cut-off report, so a fresh check on a real card is starting now and will confirm it.
